## Finding My Voice

Writing is thinking made visible. For too long, I've kept my thoughts in private notes and fragmented documents. This blog is an experiment in thinking publicly.

The format is simple on purpose. No elaborate designs, no complex JavaScript frameworks, just words and ideas. Like the old web, when content mattered more than aesthetics.

## What to Expect

I plan to write about:

- Things I'm learning
- Technical explorations
- Ideas worth sharing
- Occasional observations

The frequency will be irregular. Quality over quantity.

## Why Now

There's something about having a public space that changes how you think. When you know others might read your work, you think more carefully, write more clearly, and consider perspectives you might otherwise miss.

This is that space for me.
